# Feature Delivery End-to-End Skill

## Use When
- Planning a complete feature slice
- Coordinating multi-role implementation and handoffs
- Preparing release readiness packets

## Required Outcomes
1. Acceptance criteria and architecture constraints are explicit.
2. Implementation plan includes schema, service, API, UI, and observability as needed.
3. Test strategy covers unit, integration, and relevant UAT paths.
4. Release checklist and rollback notes are prepared.

## Workflow
1. Gather product objective and phase alignment.
2. Confirm architecture constraints and risks.
3. Break into role-owned tasks.
4. Define quality gates and evidence expectations.
5. Produce release readiness verdict.

## Output Format
1. Scope and assumptions
2. Role-by-role task plan
3. Dependency and handoff map
4. Quality gates
5. Release recommendation
